## Five newest drawings read

1. **DOC-4999f96f963f-2, rev. 1 — Tube sheet review note**  
   **Changes:** From tube sheet revision B to C: hole pitch increased from 23.8 mm to 25.4 mm to match the new baffle plate; gasket-face flatness tolerance tightened from 0.25 mm to 0.15 mm; material callout now references approved supplier list revision 12.  
   **Open actions:** Design team to update tie-rod positions on the assembly drawing; Quality to confirm drilling sequence with supplier before first article.

2. **HX-310-DWG-00155, rev. E — Expansion joint detail**  
   **Changes:** Document says changes are tracked in the engineering change notice (ECN) log; the drawing text does not state the changes.  
   **Open actions:** Not specified in the document.

3. **HX-310-DWG-00435, rev. C — Shell flange detail**  
   **Changes:** Document says changes are tracked in the ECN log; the drawing text does not state the changes.  
   **Open actions:** Not specified in the document.

4. **HX-310-DWG-00846, rev. D — Tube sheet detail**  
   **Changes:** No revision delta provided in the available text. It notes that critical-to-quality characteristics are marked on sheet one.  
   **Open actions:** Not specified in the document.

5. **HX-310-DWG-00890, rev. E — Shell flange assembly**  
   **Changes:** No revision delta provided in the available text. Material callouts reference the approved supplier list.  
   **Open actions:** Not specified in the document.

## Supporting-document review / access limits

For completeness, I listed HX-310 **specifications, test reports, and BOMs**. I read each listed specification (20), test report (20), and BOM (20) one by one. The specifications’ available text generally gives a brief status or reference, not detailed change/action descriptions. Reading the test reports and BOMs was blocked: the test report requests returned an additional-authentication challenge or pending accountable-person confirmation; the BOM requests returned pending confirmation. I could not inspect their contents, so this report does not claim those records have no further changes or actions.
